items: FedEx lifts import surcharge, adds Vietnam. The U.S. import Demand Surcharge for Europe and Israel origins rose from $0.25 to $0.28 per lb. effective Nov. 2, 2026. A new Vietnam-to-U.S. surcharge is $0.36 per lb. for priority-class services and $0.27 for economy-class.

Whatnot sellers now pay USPS weight adjustments. For shipments sent on or after Nov. 4, US sellers bear any extra postage USPS assesses when a package weighs more than declared. Whatnot had covered these charges, and sellers can appeal within 45 days.

Uber launches Deliveries parcel service in Spain. The in-app same-city service starts in 12 cities, including Madrid and Barcelona, using two-wheeled couriers. Items are limited to 40x30x20 cm, 15 kg and an estimated value of 100 euros, and no prices were given.
